ads.text: Video ad: 'Hyderabad homeowners - Ready to go solar? Own a home in Hyderabad? Go Solar. Save More. Get a FREE home survey and subsidy assistance. Call us at 9100126750.' Creative text: 'Hyderabad Homeowners: Go Solar and Get Subsidy - Reduce your monthly electricity bill with a customized rooftop solar solution. Government subsidy assistance available.'

ad_library.summary: Wisda Energy (Wisda Ventures Pvt Ltd) is running 1 active Meta video ad, started 10 October 2026, offering Hyderabad homeowners a free home survey and subsidy assistance. The click lands on an fb.me lead form inside Facebook, so the spend never reaches wisda.in. The site is a Secunderabad (Tarnaka) office serving Hyderabad with rooftop and ground-mount solar plus AMC, showcases Miyapur installations at 3 kW and 5 kW, claims 1k+ happy customers, and lists TGREDCO empanelment (TSRE240457). No Google Ads advertiser record was checked for this report - that requires the full pipeline.

funnel.meaning: Every click opens a Facebook surface, not wisda.in. You own no pixel on the landing experience, you cannot retarget the people who clicked and did not enquire, and there is no page you can test a different headline or price on. With a single video ad live there is also no second creative angle to learn from.

findings: The one live ad (since 10 Oct 2026) clicks to an fb.me lead form inside Facebook - the spend never reaches wisda.in, so no pixel, no retargeting pool, no testable landing page.

The ad's offer (free home survey + subsidy assistance) is backed on the site by the TGREDCO empanelment number, the Miyapur 3 kW / 5 kW installation case studies and the AMC service line - none of which the paid traffic ever sees.
One video ad, one angle (subsidy assistance), all cold traffic. No retargeting ad behind it and no second creative to test the ground-mount or AMC angles.
Three inboxes are published across the site and the ad (connect@wisda.in plus two Gmail addresses) with two phone numbers - an enquiry can land in any of them.
The ad is the only creative visible in the Ad Library and has been live about two weeks - the account is dependent on one video holding its performance.
next_steps: Move the click onto a page you own
Point the ad at a dedicated Hyderabad landing page carrying the free home survey + subsidy assistance offer, an enquiry form and the Meta Pixel - so every click is measurable and retargetable.
One pixel plus the Conversions API gives you the audience of everyone who clicked but did not submit the fb.me form - usually 10-20x the people who fill a form.
Test a second creative around ground-mount and AMC
The site's ground-mount and AMC lines are a separate buying trigger from the subsidy - a second creative tells you which audience converts.
Settle on one inbox and one number
Publish connect@wisda.in and one phone number everywhere (ads, forms, footer) so an enquiry can never sit unread or land on the wrong address.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
